# Cellular modem documents

SIMCom A76XX and Quectel EG25-G documents behind the compute-module respin study (MESHSAT-709, appendix 32.35, `docs/respin-research-cm5-2026-09-04.md`): the modem family of the T-Call carrier that PCB-B holds today, and the Mini PCIe alternative. Fetched 4 September 2026; the maker documents are distributor-hosted copies where the maker site does not serve them directly, and every row names the copy. The licence remark of the parent folder applies. Nothing here has been built.

| File | Source | Date | What it is used for |
|---|---|---|---|
